levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن عبد الحكم

notes: «قال شعيب» names Shu'ayb as a link before «قال حدثنا الليث»; the verb is not the name.
The Prophet's saying is reported by Abu Hurayra («أنه سمع»); the Prophet is the end of the chain.
K6I's «شعيب بن أبي حمزة» is a source claim; the text writes «شعيب» alone and the surface keeps that.
